card.name: Finding a local provider or resource
card.fires_on: Words in phrases about locating a nearby professional, library or service, such as 'find' in 'to find one near you' and 'in' before 'your town' or 'my area'. It also fires on 'listing' of centers.

modes.label: Find verb
modes.description: The verb 'find' in an invitation to locate a nearby professional or office.
modes.example: Click here to<< find>> one near you.

modes.label: Location phrase
modes.description: 'in' or 'your/my' just before a local area phrase after a find-a-professional request.
modes.example: See How can I find a genetics professional<< in>> my area?

modes.label: Directory listing
modes.description: Words pointing to a list of centers or resources to look up.
modes.example: A<< listing>> of the poison control centers can be found

card.writes: It promotes words like referrals, contacts and locator, suggesting the text goes on to a directory or contact lookup.
card.plain: It lights up when text tells readers how to find a nearby doctor, clinic or service.
